feeds.title: iRunFar
feeds.description: iRunFar is your home for ultramarathon training info. Our goal here at iRunFar.com is to provide you with the best possible information regarding trail running and ultrarunning anywhere. We provide a mix of timely news, educational information, editorial insight, race coverage, gear reviews, and other resources, all while we continue to refine our content to better serve your needs and interests.

feeds.title: Road Trail Run
feeds.description: Road Trail Run focuses on in-depth early running shoes and gear reviews. They bring you articles on Road & Trail Run Shoes, Gear & Tech By Brand, Latest Run Shoes, Hiking & Gear Reviews & Articles, and more.

feeds.title: American Trail Running Association News
feeds.description: The latest trail news, feature articles & information from the world of trail running, ultrarunning, mountain running, snowshoe racing & more.

feeds.title: Trail Sisters
feeds.description: A community of women inspiring others to lead healthy lifestyles while adventuring outdoors and protecting Earth's playgrounds. Our mission is to increase women's participation and opportunity in trail running through inspiration, education and empowerment.

feeds.title: REI » Run
feeds.description: Recreational Equipment, Inc. (REI) love to get outside and play, and they know first-hand the importance of quality outdoor gear. Read the REI Co-op Journal for stories about a life outdoors.

feeds.title: Trail Running Nepal Blog
feeds.description: Trail Running Nepal is run by a small group of people who love running and getting together to promote trail running in Nepal.

feeds.title: IAN CORLESS
feeds.description: Photography, Writing, Podcast, Speaking, Reviewing & Running.

feeds.title: Trail Roots Running Blog
feeds.description: Be the first to know about Trail Roots race specials, free events, training tips, and new gear. Trail Roots group training offers trail, track, and road runs for any level of runner. From the absolute beginner, the casual runner, to the ultra-marathoner and Boston qualifier. We strive to help you discover your best self by unplugging, lacing up, and exploring the wilderness with others.

feeds.title: Beast Coast Trail Running
feeds.description: A collection of race reports and other writings of and about ultrarunning, trail running, and other running related topics with a strong focus on the East Coast. The 'Beast Coast' has a strong trail running community and some amazing events; this blog aims to showcase some of that.

feeds.title: Trail Runner Nation
feeds.description: Our website provides a share point for information through social media and podcasts on trail running, pacing, race nutrition, running shoes and much more. One of trail running's oldest and most downloaded podcasts, devoted to sharing knowledge and advice with the trail running community - from beginners to the pros!

feeds.title: Arduua Blog
feeds.description: We are new brand specialized in Trail running, Skyrunning and Ultra-trail! Our main business is to offer runners all over the world who are training for any challenging trail race, Online Coaching, as well as training camps and race trips across the globe. Team Arduua is an international race team who are on different races, in different places, round the world, each weekend. Read inspiring stories, trail running tips, routes and more!

feeds.title: Vert.run Journal
feeds.description: Get inspired with our journal featuring success stories, tips, gear reviews and more! Vert.run provides trail running & Ultramarathon training plans and workouts by world-class athletes for trail running races of 50k, 80k, 100k, and more.

feeds.title: Nova Scotia Trail Running
feeds.description: This blog brings you the latest news related to trail running from Nova Scotia, Canada.

feeds.title: Running John
feeds.description: John Burton is a software product manager by morning, ultra runner by mid-afternoon. If he is not half-asleep on some conference call you can find him out on the trails tearing it up. Or slogging it out. Or just sitting on a comfortable rock in the sun catching his breath.

feeds.title: Soiled Sport
feeds.description: Trail Running in London, Ontario and surrounding area.

feeds.title: Trail Running for Life
feeds.description: Covers articles, stories and videos all about trail running, ultra running and the benefits associated with these topics from physical to mental. Posts also dip into gear, techniques, and personal experiences.

feeds.title: FN Trail Running Cheshire
feeds.description: I am an trail & off-road running coach based in Stockport and on the Cheshire / Derbyshire border. I can help you improve your running; on, or off road. My site started out very much as a personal blogging space, covering my running as well as my other interests.

feeds.title: Trail Running Movement Blog
feeds.description: The site offers professional advice on training and nutrition, share race info and stories around the Word, promote events and describe new trails. Trail Running Movement is a sports company specialising in trail running, endurance ultra trails, and running.

feeds.title: Canadian Trail Running Magazine
feeds.description: Canada's premiere running publication. Catch up on the latest news, race recaps, features and more with us. Stay up to date on all the updates and news on trail running events in Canada, gear reviews, products launch and more!

feeds.title: RUN247
feeds.description: The global home of the off-road running news and participation advice. RUN247 provides news coverage from the iconic sky, mountain & trail running events from around the world and stories about amazing athletes that epitomise what is great about this sport. Additionally, we offer a range of off-road running tips and advice for runners of all ages and experience including running shoe and other gear reviews, training advice, nutrition & health recommendations and much more.

feeds.title: TrailRun Magazine
feeds.description: Trail Run Magazine is Australia and New Zealand's original and best, grassroots, mud-encrusted, dirty-kneed trail running magazine. Forget the boring bitumen, we are entirely devoted to the dirty art of trail running. If it's through a forest, up mountains, across deserts, or wild and adrenaline-pumping, we'll cover it!

feeds.title: Ultra Runner Girl
feeds.description: Stephanie Case is an Ultra runner, freelance writer, human-rights lawyer and founder of the nonprofit Free to Run. She writes about running, war zones, and everything in between.

feeds.title: Liza Howard
feeds.description: Liza Howard is a national champion runner with multiple records in distances ranging from marathons to 100 mile trail races. Her posts include recaps of races and everyday training runs in Texas.

feeds.title: Northeast Trail Running
feeds.description: Officially launched in March 2023, NETR celebrates trail running culture and community in the Northeast United States with features, profiles, events, news, gear reviews, and more. Northeast Trail Running is a website devoted to trail and ultra running in the Northeast.

feeds.title: Runblogger » Trail Running
feeds.description: Runblogger is edited and authored almost exclusively by Peter Larson. Since 2007 Peter have completed nine marathons (including Boston), one ultra marathon, and numerous shorter distance races. Follow their blog for running shoes & gear reviews and posts on the science of the sport.

feeds.title: Rockhoppin' Trail
feeds.description: Three decades of ultra-distance running began with a chunk of years on tar (10 Comrades, 16 Two Oceans) and followed with almost 20 years of trail, racing through canyons, on beaches, deserts, islands, glaciers, salt flats, over mountains, escarpments and peaks. During the last five years I've added a coaching focus, passing on the lessons I've learned to help others seeking to reach beyond their comfort zones discover their full potential. Explore my stories and tips here.

feeds.title: Northwest Trail Runs Blog
feeds.description: Trail Running Blog by Northwest Trail Runs, featuring shoe reviews, interviews, course previews and more.

feeds.title: Leor Pantilat's Adventures
feeds.description: Leor Pantilat is a member of the La Sportiva Mountain Running Team. An avid trail runner and adventure runner.

feeds.title: A Trail Runner's Blog
feeds.description: Scott Dunlap's blog of trail running, ultra running, triathlon, and other life adventures. This blog contains interviews, research, original fiction, new product ideas, and all things trail running.

feeds.title: Karl Meltzer Blog
feeds.description: Karl Meltzer ultra runner with most career wins in 100-mile races and current AT Record holder.

feeds.title: Jesse Luna
feeds.description: Jesse Luna is an award-winning blogger, technologist, and activist. He has been focused on empowering communities through technology education since 1990. Follow his trekking activities, and activism work along with other updates here.

feeds.title: Fletcher's Challenge 2024
feeds.description: Runners of Compassion is a registered non-profit society whose members participate as a group to raise awareness of and provide funding for social and charitable causes.

feeds.title: Trail Running UK Blog
feeds.description: My name is Graham Patten. I have a life time of trail running experience to share with you stretching back more than 40 years. This blog is about the people, places and events that have helped shaped my approach and thoughts about trail running through the years. I've always tried to help inspire others to enjoy the sports I love the most. I sincerely hope my tales of trail running from my own experiences, both past and present, will inspire you to even greater enjoyment during your own trail running adventures.

feeds.title: Southeastern Trail Runs Blog
feeds.description: Southeastern Trail Runs hosts seven races each year in the Birmingham area. One additional race on lake martin, 90 miles south of Birmingham, near Alexander city. Explore the blog to know more about our races, participants, stories and more!

feeds.title: Trisport » Trail Running
feeds.description: TriSport specializes in Event Management, Coaching, Training Clinics, Sport Travel, Sport Tourism and Sport Retail Gear. Their blog focuses on trial running events in South Africa.

feeds.title: Upper Midwest Trail Runners News
feeds.description: The Upper Midwest Trail Runners is an organization for anyone who likes to run off road - whether dirt, grass, rocks, mud, snow - really, any trail that isn't paved.

feeds.title: Sabrina Little Ultramarathons
feeds.description: Sabrina Little is a Trail and Ultra runner. She is a 3 times national champion and also a former 24-hour and 200K American women's record holder. She frequently posts race reports on her blog.

feeds.title: Big Tesuque Trail Run
feeds.description: Big Tesuque Trail Run is a twelve mile high-altitude trail run organized by the Santa Fe Striders each year since 1985. The race tops out at 12,0003ft on Tesuque Peak.

feeds.title: Ellie Greenwood, Trail Running Tales
feeds.description: Ellie Greenwood is an ultra runner and online ultra runner coach. Subscribe to her blog for her various trail running and ultra running tales.

feeds.title: Alps Insight
feeds.description: Explore stories, trip reports, gear reviews, training tips, interviews and news from the Alps. ALPSinsight is an inspiring resource for people seeking mountain sport experiences in the Alps. The recommendations are a curated list of quality routes by industry professionals. As a Collective, we are a team of professional mountain sport content providers for the outdoor industry, editorial & commercial clients, brand partners, and destinations seeking the highest quality services for producing their own custom content.

feeds.title: The Roving Runner
feeds.description: Jan Ham started running trail a couple of years ago, and fell in love with it straight away. His blog contains product reviews and his trail running stories.

feeds.title: Rock Creek Runner Blog
feeds.description: Rock Creek Runner helps runners of all levels discover what running can mean to them.
